article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 22 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Edgar Bergen & Charlie McCarthy, Buck Rogers, Family Doctor, and Country Music Time
article-meta.kwd-group: Edgar Bergen, Charlie McCarthy, Fred Allen, WC Fields, Abbott and Costello, Buck Rogers, Cocomalt, Popsicle Pete, Family Doctor, Willis Brothers, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 58 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 58 resolves 22 historical radio broadcasts spanning legendary network comedy, pioneering science-fiction radio serials, syndicated medical human-interest drama, and military recruitment country music: 6 landmark broadcasts from ***The Edgar Bergen & Charlie McCarthy Show*** (1939–1956, featuring historic appearances by Fred Allen, Abbott & Costello, W.C. Fields, Ida Lupino, and their 20th Anniversary retrospective), 6 episodes of the classic 1939 juvenile sci-fi serial ***Buck Rogers in the 25th Century*** (featuring Dr. Huer's Mechanical Mole and the search for Killer Kane near Pluto), 8 syndicated episodes of ***Family Doctor*** (starring Grant Richards as small-town physician Dr. Jim Adams, 1938), and 2 musical variety broadcasts from ***Country Music Time*** (featuring The Willis Brothers and Spike Jones & His City Slickers).
